title: Why is popcorn puffy?
hook: Hello friends! Pop, pop, pop! Why does a tiny hard seed turn into fluffy popcorn?
answer: Every popcorn seed has a tiny drop of water hiding inside a hard shell. When the seed is warmed up, the water turns into steam. Steam needs much more room, so it pushes on the shell like air filling a balloon. When the shell cannot hold on, it bursts, and the soft inside puffs out.
wowFact: Here is a wow fact! When a popcorn seed bursts, it can jump higher than your knee. That is why it pops with such a loud noise.
experiment: Try this! Look closely at a few popcorn seeds and some popped popcorn. Line them up and compare the sizes. How many seeds fit in one puff? Count them!

onScreenText.experiment: Try it: compare seeds and puffs

description: Bolt finds out why hard popcorn seeds burst into fluffy puffs. Then he compares the sizes of seeds and puffs in a simple counting experiment.
